scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && echo 'Type check passed. Use build:dev or build:prod to produce dist/'
scripts.build:dev: rm -rf dist && rolldown -c && mkdir -p dist/resources && cp -r src/resources/. dist/resources/ && cp -r node_modules/@digitalservicebund/unternehmen-steuer-gewerbe-privat/dist/ERiC-44.2.4.0 dist/ERiC-44.2.4.0 && cp -r node_modules/@digitalservicebund/unternehmen-steuer-gewerbe-privat/dist/resources/. dist/resources/
scripts.build:prod: pnpm build:dev && rm -rf node_modules && pnpm install --prod
scripts.build:image: pnpm build:prod && docker build . --tag ${IMAGE_TAG:-unternehmen-steuer-gewerbe} --build-arg COMMIT_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD); status=$?; pnpm install; exit $status
scripts.start:image: op run --env-file .env -- docker run -p 3000:3000 -e ERIC_HERSTELLERID -e ERIC_CERTIFICATE_BASE64 -e ERIC_CERTIFICATE_PIN -e FIT_CONNECT_OAUTH_TOKEN_URL -e FIT_CONNECT_SUBMISSION_API_URL -e FIT_CONNECT_DESTINATION_API_URL -e FIT_CONNECT_ROUTING_API_URL -e FIT_CONNECT_CLIENT_ID -e FIT_CONNECT_CLIENT_SECRET -e TEST_FIT_CONNECT_DESTINATION_ID_OVERRIDE -e FIT_CONNECT_PUBLIC_KEY_ENCRYPTION_JWK -e FIT_CONNECT_PRIVATE_KEY_DECRYPTION_JWK -e TEST_OSCI_ARS_OVERRIDE unternehmen-steuer-gewerbe
scripts.start:watch: op run --env-file .env -- nodemon --watch . --ignore dist --ext ts,json,yml,md --exec pnpm run start
